proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Produce Flame's attack is optional: the caster may spend a Magic action during the spell's 10-minute duration to make a ranged spell attack. This is distinct from all existing OngoingTrigger variants. passive fires unconditionally; on_caster_attack_hit fires when an existing attack hits (it doesn't grant a new attack). The v4 taxonomy already names action_window as a Window Atom, but OngoingTrigger has no variant that exposes it. A new variant { kind: 'on_caster_action'; actionKind: StandardActionKind } would express 'while this effect persists, if the caster spends the named action, the effect fires'. This covers Produce Flame (Magic action -> ranged spell attack) and would generalize to any future ongoing effect triggered by an optional caster-action expenditure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.

notes: The ongoing_effect family is structurally correct. Three parts encode cleanly: emit_light for the passive light (20ft bright / 20ft dim additional), threshold_tiers with axis=character for the 1d8/2d8/3d8/4d8 cantrip scaling, and caster_recasts_spell as the earlyEnd trigger on the timed 10-minute duration. The sole gap is the OngoingTrigger variant for the optional Magic-action attack. Encoding only the light would omit a core mechanic and produce a misleading trace, so no dhall/json/trace was authored.
